property: The advisory test lane target exists and its recipe actually runs commands.
The fast gate target exists and its recipe actually runs commands.
The ownership file is present and assigns at least one owner.
The runbook file is present and non-empty.
The SLO document is present and non-empty.
The alerts document is present and non-empty.
The ratio of test code to production code is reported (informational, never blocking).
Static analysis reports no finding at the configured level.
The repository's architectural fitness tests run and pass.
Each source module's declared domain role agrees with the topology file and no module imports across a forbidden domain edge.
The verification probe itself contains no construct that can report a false match (producer piped into a quiet matcher, global field-separator change).
Property-based tests exist and are executed in this run.
A mutation-testing baseline artifact exists for the unit (trend row).
The failure-mode scenario matrix is present and each scenario names the test or check that covers it.
The spec declares the partition key for horizontal scale, or ratifies a single-writer decline.
The spec declares its durability trade-off from the closed vocabulary.
The spec states a bound on recovery time, or ratifies a manual-intervention decline.
The spec states the compatibility policy for the published contract, or ratifies that nothing is published.
The spec declares a retention policy for stored data, or ratifies a decline.
The spec names the mechanism that deletes personal data, from a closed vocabulary.
Log records carry the trace correlation identifiers.
The structured log handler is installed by the production entry point.
A tracer is initialised and driven on the production start path, not only defined.
Inbound and outbound calls propagate the caller trace context.
Every implemented mechanism is invoked by something on the production path, not merely present.
The dependency vulnerability scanner runs and reports no reachable known vulnerability.
Dependencies are pinned in a committed lockfile that CI enforces and does not regenerate.
Chaos experiments are declared with a hypothesis and an abort condition.
Delivery is progressive and has a rehearsed rollback.
A semantic dataflow security scan runs and its findings block the merge.
Every state-changing entry point is behind an authentication check.
Every CI workflow definition parses and references only things that exist.
The secret scan runs on every trigger that can introduce a commit.
A software bill of materials is produced for the shipped artifact.
The shipped artifact carries signed build provenance.
A scheduled run exists and records trend data over time.
Service-level objectives are defined and ratified by a human.
Every deployed workload declares CPU and memory limits.
Every metric series the runbook cites exists among the declared series, and at least one is cited.
The liability registries are present.
The registry checker runs and an expired entry fails the build.
The context and change-plan artifacts for the work exist and are populated.
Every ratified invariant has a ratification package backing it.
Every citation in a ratification package resolves to something that exists.
Tests marked as unratified candidates are kept out of the blocking lane.
Every test function this change adds carries a provenance header.
CI workflows run every fuzz target the standard requires.
CI workflows run the real-dependency integration lane.
The lines this change adds or edits are covered by tests at the declared threshold.
The shipped artifact can carry a non-empty build revision and builds reproducibly.
A load or soak harness exists and records the arrival rate at which the system stops keeping up.
Error handlers do not swallow, ignore or only log a critical failure.
A deterministic simulation lane is present (advisory, cannot fail).
After a forced kill and restart the persisted state is identical to before the kill.
An alert exists whose client-side signal is a series the service itself does not emit.
The probe could derive its own list of declared rows (the not-probed guard is armed).
